creep_score.label: Creep score
creep_score.note: Creep score is explicitly defined by this project as last hits plus denies.

runes.label: Runes
runes.note: Do not sum players[].runes; the actual EWC payload does not consistently equal rune_pickups.

teamfight_participation.label: Teamfight participation
teamfight_participation.note: Use OpenDota's parsed value; it is not always equal to (kills + assists) / final team score.

smokes.label: Smokes used
smokes.note: This measures uses, not purchases. purchase.smoke_of_deceit is a different statistic.

roshan_kills.label: Roshan kills
roshan_kills.note: OpenDota defines this as player last hits on Roshan; do not rebuild it from players[].killed.

tormentor_kills.label: Tormentor kills
tormentor_kills.note: No documented dedicated OpenDota player field exists. The internal killed map is not a reliable substitute.

first_blood.label: First blood
first_blood.note: Cross-checkable against objectives[].type == CHAT_MESSAGE_FIRSTBLOOD and player_slot.
